In RAN1 #109, two alternatives on the report quantity for TDCP report were identified as follows: The TDCP measurement can be performed based on TRS only. It is unnecessary to report the TDCP associated with other CSIs. In addition, for precoded TRS based TDCP measurement, the precoder for the TDCP can be derived based on some prior CSI.
